light_test.mbt.name: light: a light inside one tile lands in exactly that tile
light: a light on a tile boundary does not bleed one tile too far
light: a light covering the whole viewport lists every tile
light: lights outside the viewport are culled by span, not by luck
light: the 2.5D slab really culls a raised light
light: ground_radius is the 2.5D footprint, and shrinks with height
light: span_radius never under-covers what the exact test accepts
light: the per-tile cap keeps the top-k by importance
light: cap large enough to hold everything changes nothing
light: the incremental pass agrees with the full pass after a drag
light: an incremental pass with nothing dirty does no work
light: moving a light off a tile removes it from that tile
light: a dirty grid wider than a quarter falls back to a full pass
light: pack_words round-trips into a readable block
light: empty light list and zero-radius lights are not special cases
light: pack_lights lays out eight floats per light
light: a light exactly at its reach distance is on the boundary
light: touching a moved light marks exactly its old and new spans
light: a light has a span exactly when it can reach the grid
light: the span is tight around the light, never a whole-grid fallback
